decision: Keep original default. All three400ms screens failed their predeclared promotion gate. Pika1000ms results are exploratory direct controls, not a replacement for failed own-baseline gates.
limitations: Focused depth describes one common completed-candidate tier, not all roots. Frontier coverage and fullRootDepth are reported.
Finite exploration can omit the same-depth best root; root reset plus exact-depth cache lookup ensures comparable scores, not globally optimal selection.
At the8-ply cap this frozen rejected prototype can stop before using all time with roots still shallow; retained as a limitation, not silently patched during validation.
Tactical checks activate from public king-danger geometry at request start; later revealed threats can be missed. q-depth/cycle limits remain.
Screens use different fixed layouts per variant, so percentage differences between variants are not causal ablations; same-position four-way matrices are separate.
Pika control uses four correlated layouts per implementation and an unchanged HCE opponent with known color asymmetry. No stable Elo or claim of exceeding Pika.
No new automatic real-browser run after the earlier browser URL-policy denial. Simulated-DOM and loopback API checks are labeled as such.
Pilot5-game non-production control and initial checker/HTTP-client failures retained separately; never mixed into formal scores.
